findingDetails.title: A sibling link that resolves back inside the tree is refused with the wrong reason
findingDetails.scopeProof: the sibling branch at :452-477 is the only place a ../ value can be accepted, and every path through it that does not return lands on :478
findingDetails.case: a tree at <ws>/skilled whose setting names ../linked, where <ws>/linked is a symlink to <ws>/skilled/overlays, exits 2 with 'names a folder outside the tree root' although the folder resolves inside the tree
findingDetails.claim: the fall-through refusal at :478 reports a path escape for a sibling that resolves inside the tree
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked whether the sibling branch returns before :478 for an in-tree target; it does not, because the isWithin guard at :466 is false for an in-tree target
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the message may be intended to cover every non-sibling ../ value, and an in-tree link is arguably not a sibling folder
